title: The drawer doesn’t open
text: The drawer doesn’t open. I can’t use it because the drawer is stuck and has to be yanked on to get it open and I’m afraid over time, this will cause it to break! So I need to replace this appliance. I’m afraid to use it, it may have more problems Update: got the drawer open, tried it out, made French fries and the motor is so weak that it took an hour to cook and the end results was the fries were soggy and partially cooked, disgusting! Very disappointed but, you get what you pay for! Don’t waste your money

product_metadata.title: DASH Tasti-Crisp™ Digital Air Fryer with AirCrisp Technology, Custom Presets, Temperature Control, and Auto Shut Off Feature, 2.6 Quart - Black
features: HEALTHIER FRIED FOOD: Dash Digital Tasti-Crisp Air Fryer uses AirCrisp technology (instead of oil) to help reduce added fat by 70-80%, without sacrificing the flavor of your fried food (no more residual smell hours after you’ve eaten).

QUICK + EASY: Short on time? Simply load the 2.6 qt Capacity Air Fryer basket, set the temp, and set the timer. Your food comes out crispy, guaranteed, every time. And in less time than it takes to pre-heat your oven, making it energy efficient as well.

CUSTOM PRESETS AND DIGITAL INTERFACE: Three saved preset buttons allow you to choose and save your favorite cooking settings, while the Digital Interface allows for maximum control over time and temperature, from 200-400°F and up to 60 minutes.
SAFER: The auto-shut off function prevents overcooking, and the cool touch housing and handle makes it safer to use. It’s so simple, even your kids can use it

COMPACT + LIGHTWEIGHT: Half the weight of a standard fryer, the Dash Digital Tasti-Crisp Air Fryer is your countertop must-have, while its versatility makes it a perfect fit for that first apartment, smaller kitchen, college dorm, camper/RV traveling and more.
description: Cook crispy fried food in a dash with the Tasti-Crisp™ Air Fryer! AirCrisp® technology fries with hot air instead of oil, for delicious fried food with up to 75% less fat than a traditional deep fryer. This convenient countertop air fryer is sized for any kitchen, making it easier to store while still providing ample 2.6 qt capacity. This version of the Tasti-Crisp™ Air Fryer has a digital interface for easily setting time and temperature, and has three buttons that allow you to choose and save your own presets for easy cooking. Perfect for cooking frozen treats like chicken nuggets, fish sticks, and other snacks, the Digital Tasti-Crisp™ is a compact air fryer families will love.
